regions.today: A wet start this morning with outbreaks of rain, heavy and possibly thundery in places, with some flooding possible, especially further south. A clearance to sunny spells and isolated showers will extend from the south through the morning. Winds will be moderate to fresh and gusty south to southeast for a time, stronger at times in coastal parts, veering westerly as the rain clears, and will ease in the evening. Highest temperatures of 14 to 18 degrees.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be mainly dry with clear spells and just the odd isolated light shower. Lowest temperatures of 5 to 10 degrees with winds becoming mostly light southerly.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Monday, will be mainly dry and bright with long spells of sunshine, turning hazy at times and with just the chance of an isolated shower or two. Highest temperatures of 14 to 18 degrees in mostly light to moderate southerly winds, backing southeasterly.
